text:
|Time|Ready queue|Analysis|
|--|--|--|
|0|**P1**|Only P1 has arrived, so P1 is put on the processor|
|7|P2, **P3**, P4|P1 finishes running and voluntarily gives up the processor; all other processes have arrived, and P3 has the highest priority, so P3 is put on the processor|
|8|**P2**, P4|P3 finishes; P2 and P4 have the same priority, and since P2 arrived first, P2 is put on the processor first|
|12|**P4**|P2 finishes; only P4 remains in the ready queue, so P4 is put on the processor|
|16|-|P4 finishes; all processes have ended|
